files.description: Bike-share trips, 1 September to 1 November 2025 (1500 rows): trip_id (whole number), rider_id (refers to riders.csv), start_station and end_station (refer to station_code in stations.csv), started_at (timestamp written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), duration_min (whole minutes; about 3% empty), distance_km (two decimals), fare (two decimals; about 3% empty), payment (card, app or cash; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), rating (1-5 stars, whole number; about 19% empty).

task_text: For each payment method (trim spaces and use lower case), find the 3 longest trips by duration_min, preferring the smaller trip_id when durations are equal. `result` should be a table with the columns payment, trip_id and duration_min, sorted by payment and then from the longest to the shortest trip.
intended_computation: Read trips.csv, normalise payment (strip, lower case), ignore trips with an empty duration_min, and for each payment method keep the 3 trips with the largest duration_min (ties broken by smaller trip_id); return payment, trip_id, duration_min sorted by payment ascending and duration_min descending.
notes: invited_ids_author labelled by hand after the intents were frozen (step A2); intent not rewritten for it.
